messages:
Maria C: Kicking off a fast pass on landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages — goal is one coherent launch set that covers: launch posts, benchmark narrative, webinar signup flow, and inbound lead routing. Can we keep this lean and testable?
AJ: Love it. Quick ask — can we standardize the CTA matrix across the three pages? My suggestion: Hosted -> `Start free API`, Dedicated -> `Reserve capacity`, Private -> `Contact sales / Private demo`. Short, explicit.
Erica (prod): Agree on the CTAs. Also we need a tiny benchmark panel under hero: 3 bullets (latency example, cost delta, real-world throughput). Tone: concrete but non-nerdy.
Tarek: Micro-copy suggestion for hero subhead: "Production-grade LLM inference across hosted, reserved, and private deployments." Shorten if needed: "Production-grade LLM inference, wherever you run it."
Lina: For webinar routing — propose different nurture paths so we don't spam AEs with self-serve signups:
```
Hosted -> marketing_nurture (auto email + on-demand demo)
Dedicated -> sales_nurture (AE touch, tag:reserved)
Private -> enterprise_sales (security + compliance follow-up)
```
Sam: A/B test idea: Hero phrasing A = "High-throughput inference for your app" vs B = "Predictable latency and cost at scale". 2-week run, track CTAs and signups.
Maria C: For launch posts: lead with the affordance (same API, pick your deployment) + one example: "Retail search cut latency 30% after moving to Dedicated" — keep it digestible. We can link to a short benchmark page.
Erica (prod): On the form, please add `deployment_interest` dropdown with values Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Use that to tag leads in HubSpot. Also capture `target_scale` (tokens/sec) as optional.
Tarek: I'll wire the form field. Question: should `deployment_interest` be required on the main enterprise page only? My vote: required on Private page, optional on Dedicated, hidden on Hosted.
Lina: Messaging iteration plan: I'll produce 3 hero variants + 3 subheads + CTA matrix in a single doc. Will also sketch the webinar blurb (1-sentence + 3 bullet topics: benchmarks, routing & cost controls, rollout strategies). Expect by EOD.
Sam: I'll draft the webinar copy: short blurb + 2 CTAs (Register / Share with my team). Also suggest putting a short benchmark snapshot in the webinar landing page to pre-qualify attendees.
Maria C: Nice. Prioritization: Lina's doc -> Sam webinar blurb -> Tarek form hooks -> AJ A/B test setup. Revisit tomorrow 11am.
AJ: Small nits for copy: avoid jargon like "KV cache" on marketing pages. Use "caching and batching" only in technical doc.
Erica (prod): For benchmark numbers, we should show ranges and a footnote: "results vary by model and sequence length". Legal ok with that.
Tarek: Implementation note: add hidden input `utm_deployment` when routing from launch posts so we can join data across campaigns.
Lina: Will include two headline tones: trust-led (SLA + predictable) and velocity-led (fast + low-latency). Suggest we A/B test those too.
Sam: I'll also prepare 3 short social posts for launch (hosted angle, dedicated case study, private compliance story) — one-liners + CTAs.
Maria C: Thanks all. Anyone want to own the benchmark microcopy? Need 2 short sentences + 3 bullets (latency, cost per 1k tokens, typical throughput) that are friendly and non-technical.
Erica (prod): I'll take benchmark microcopy and ping legal for a quick sign-off.
deploy-bot: update: product-deck-v2 pushed to /shared/decks (link)
Maria C: Perfect. Next sync tomorrow 11am. If anyone hits blockers, drop screenshots here. :thumbsup:
